dataSource: City of Chicago Building Permits (Socrata dataset ydr8-5enu), queried live
notes: Pulled live from the City of Chicago's public permit system on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.

Matched by house number and street name, with the leading direction (N/S/E/W) parsed out of the searched street separately, since Chicago stores it as its own field rather than part of the street name.
summary: Chicago is covered by a live query against the city's public Building Permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
